minor.comment: Add @vielzeug/atlas: viewport-centred camera with cached transforms and anchor-preserving zoom, Map-like dynamic R-tree spatial index, matrix/rect math with closed-interval queries, narrow-phase hit-testing, alignment/grid/equal-gap snapping with kind-tagged guides, and the @vielzeug/atlas/grid subpath with tile math, shadowcasting FOV, and fog-of-war.
